templates.source: Advidia (i-PRO) current M-series cameras are Uniview OEM — confirmed by the official i-PRO Advidia manuals ('Advidia 2MP Network camera User Manual v1.0', models M-24-FW-T/M-26-FW/M-29-FW, i-pro.com/.../advidia%202MP%20Network%20camera_User%20Manual_v1.0_0.pdf; '4MP Advidia Network camera User Manual v1.0', models M-49-FW/M-400-P, i-pro.com/.../4MP_Advidia%20Network%20camera_User%20Manual_v1.0.pdf) whose Web-UI (Setup>Video>Media Stream, third stream, RTSP Multicast Address, Transparent Channel, Registration/vendor-hide) is the Uniview platform. Uniview's own official RTSP path is published in 'How to Get a Uniview Camera's RTSP Stream? v1.1' (global.uniview.com/.../How to Get a Uniview Camera's RTSP Stream_...pdf): Main stream rtsp://IP:554/media/video1
Uniview 'How to Get a Uniview Camera's RTSP Stream? v1.1' (official OEM doc): Sub stream rtsp://IP:554/media/video2 — applies to Advidia M-series (Uniview OEM, see main-stream source)

Uniview 'How to Get a Uniview Camera's RTSP Stream? v1.1' (official OEM doc): Third stream rtsp://IP:554/media/video3; the Advidia M-series manuals document a configurable third stream. Only some models support it.

Legacy Advidia A-series (A-34W, A-37FW, A-47, VP-16-V2, etc.) are Hikvision OEM and use the standard Hikvision RTSP path /Streaming/Channels/<ch><stream> — 101 = channel 1 main. Confirmed by OEM lineage (Advidia A-series = rebranded Hikvision) and matching the dominant StrixCamDB leads (/Streaming/Channels/101, /Streaming/Channels/1). Published on OEM basis; no standalone official Advidia doc prints this literal path (i-PRO's NVR manual instructs 'contact the camera manufacturer for the resource path').
Legacy Advidia A-series (Hikvision OEM): Hikvision RTSP path /Streaming/Channels/102 = channel 1 sub-stream (103 = third). Published on OEM basis; see legacy-hikvision-main source.

unverified_leads.note: Dahua-style path — Dahua cross-brand contamination; not confirmed for any Advidia line (current M-series is Uniview, legacy A-series is Hikvision). Excluded.
malformed Dahua/Hikvision channel mashup lead — not a valid documented path.
generic legacy MPEG-4 lead (also seen without leading slash) — not confirmed by Uniview or Hikvision official docs for Advidia.
generic legacy MPEG-4 lead — not in Uniview/Hikvision official RTSP docs; cross-brand.
generic ch<N>_<N>.h264 lead (also /ch2_0.h264) — not the Uniview /media/videoN nor Hikvision /Streaming/Channels form; cross-brand contamination.
generic lead — not a documented Advidia RTSP resource path.
generic /stream1 lead — not the documented Uniview or Hikvision path for Advidia.
ONVIF media entry lead — Advidia supports ONVIF for auto-discovery, but the RTSP resource URL is delivered via the ONVIF GetStreamUri response, not this fixed path.
Hikvision NVR-style high channel index (901/902/1103) — NVR/multi-channel lead, not a single-camera main/sub path; case-varied duplicates ignored.

notes: Advidia is a Panasonic i-PRO reseller brand whose cameras are OEM'd, and the OEM has changed across generations — so there are TWO documented RTSP families. (1) Current M-series (M-24-FW-T, M-26-FW, M-29-FW, M-46-FW, M-49-FW, M-400-P, etc.) = Uniview (UNV) OEM: the official i-PRO Advidia 2MP/4MP user manuals show the Uniview Web-UI, and Uniview's official RTSP doc gives /media/video1 (main), /media/video2 (sub), /media/video3 (third), port 554. (2) Legacy A-series and some VP-series (A-34W, A-37FW, A-47, VP-16-V2) = Hikvision OEM: standard Hikvision /Streaming/Channels/<ch><stream> — 101 main, 102 sub, 103 third; published on OEM-lineage basis (this also matches the dominant leads). No single official Advidia document prints a literal RTSP URL string (i-PRO's NVR manual explicitly says to 'contact the camera manufacturer for the resource path'), so the literal paths come from the confirmed OEMs' own docs. Also note some very old Advidia/VP units (Dahua-based /cam/realmonitor) exist in leads but were NOT confirmed and are excluded as cross-brand contamination. All families default to RTSP port 554; ONVIF is supported for auto-discovery on all.
